verdict.rationale: Alloy's Events API lets users map event types to Source Workflows, which then run automatically, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met. Documented examples include interdicting transactions, step-up after PII changes and rejecting unusual logins. Journeys can chain workflows for multi-step decisioning, and webhooks fire on asynchronous events. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how rules and conditions are authored in the workflow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
